title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
title_zh: G$^3$-LoRA: 一种基于梯度引导分组的 LoRA 数据组织方法

paragraphs.en: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assumes that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G 3 -LoRA ( G radient- G uided G rouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.
paragraphs.zh: 在异构奖励加权数据上对基础视频模型进行后训练，通常假设所有数据类别都能引发兼容的更新。 当不同类别对应不同的技能、领域或评估维度时，这一假设会变得脆弱。 我们在文本到视频的后训练任务中研究这一问题，其中 VBench2.0 的维度定义了数据桶，而一个外部多模态奖励流程负责分配样本权重。 我们提出了 G 3 -LoRA（梯度引导分组 LoRA），这是一种数据组织流程：它探测由奖励加权视频样本引发的类别级梯度，移除共享的全局更新方向，根据残差梯度兼容性对类别进行聚类，训练各组的特定 LoRA 专家，并通过权重合并以及从专家模型进行的策略内蒸馏，将它们整合为一个适配器。 我们将奖励加权的流匹配视为速度场回归，以此说明该流程的合理性：不兼容的奖励维度可能在重叠的含噪潜在区域中偏好不同的去噪方向，导致共享 LoRA 训练时能力被平均化。 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers 上，合并后的分组适配器在匹配的 VBench2.0 评估中优于基础模型、联合奖励加权 LoRA 基线，以及使用相同流程训练的随机、语义和原始梯度分区；独立评估者也证实了这一点，而在 CogVideoX-2B 上，分组方法避免了联合训练带来的负迁移。 这种提升并非均匀一致：合并过程压缩了最大专家模型带来的增益，蒸馏恢复了一部分损失，但相机运动和某些局部质量维度仍然具有挑战性。 综合来看，这些结果表明梯度兼容性可以作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的一种实用诊断方法。

paragraphs.en: Post-training pipelines increasingly rely on heterogeneous supervision. A single adapter may be trained on data from multiple domains, tasks, preference sources, or quality dimensions. The default engineering choice is simple: mix all data and optimize one model. This choice is convenient, but it hides a strong assumption: data categories that share a model should also share compatible optimization directions.
paragraphs.zh: 训练后流程越来越依赖异构监督。 单个适配器可能基于来自多个领域、任务、偏好来源或质量维度的数据进行训练。 默认的工程选择很简单：混合所有数据并优化一个模型。 这种选择虽然方便，但隐藏了一个强烈的假设：共享同一模型的数据类别也应该共享兼容的优化方向。

paragraphs.en: This paper asks whether that assumption should be measured rather than accepted. We focus on text-to-video generation because evaluation already decomposes model quality into multiple dimensions. VBench and VBench2.0 evaluate properties such as human identity, camera motion, material change, multi-view consistency, and complex plot faithfulness ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . These dimensions are usually treated as reporting axes after generation, but they can also define post-training data buckets. A model can generate candidate videos for each bucket, an external multimodal model can score them, and the resulting reward-weighted data can be used to train a LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . The open question is how those buckets should be combined before adapter training.
paragraphs.zh: 本文探讨了这一假设是应当被接受，还是应当被衡量。 我们专注于文本到视频生成，因为现有的评估方法已经将模型质量分解为多个维度。 VBench 和 VBench2.0 评估了诸如人类身份、相机运动、材质变化、多视角一致性以及复杂情节忠实度等特性（Huang 等人，2024；Zheng 等人，2025）。 这些维度通常在生成后被用作报告轴，但它们也可以定义训练后的数据分桶。 模型可以为每个分桶生成候选视频，外部多模态模型可以对其进行评分，而由此得到的奖励加权数据可用于训练 LoRA 适配器（Hu 等人，2022）。 尚未解决的问题是，在适配器训练之前，这些分桶应当如何组合。

paragraphs.en: The answer is not obvious. Some dimensions appear semantically related but may prefer different local updates; others appear unrelated but may share geometric, temporal, or object-centric structure. Human identity consistency may reward stable subject appearance, while dynamic attribute tasks emphasize visible change. Camera motion and multi-view consistency may share 3D structure, but they can differ in how much motion the generated video should contain. A single mixed adapter may improve average quality while quietly degrading conflict-heavy dimensions. Conversely, training one adapter per dimension avoids interference but loses data sharing. We therefore treat category organization as a first-class post-training problem.
paragraphs.zh: 答案并不显而易见。 某些维度在语义上看似相关，但可能偏好不同的局部更新；而其他维度看似无关，却可能共享几何、时间或对象中心的结构。 人类身份的一致性可能会奖励稳定的主体外观，而动态属性任务则强调可见的变化。 相机运动和多视角一致性可能共享三维结构，但在生成的视频应包含多少运动方面可能存在差异。 单个混合适配器可能在提升平均质量的同时，悄然削弱冲突严重的维度。 相反，为每个维度训练一个独立的适配器可以避免干扰，但会失去数据共享的优势。 因此，我们将类别组织视为一个一级后训练问题。

paragraphs.en: The key mechanism is specific to diffusion and flow SFT. Sample-level rewards do not directly optimize a scalar preference at inference time; instead, they reweight the regression of the denoising or velocity field. Each evaluation dimension can therefore be viewed as inducing a reward-reweighted conditional velocity field. When multiple dimensions favor incompatible generation behaviors, their preferred velocity directions may conflict in overlapping noisy latent regions. Since the MSE objective learns a conditional mean target, joint training with a shared LoRA can average these directions, producing gradient interference and capability averaging. To address this, we organize data categories by their measured optimization compatibility before training grouped adapters.
paragraphs.zh: 关键机制专用于扩散和流 SFT。 样本级奖励在推理时不会直接优化标量偏好；相反，它们会重新加权去噪或速度场的回归。 因此，每个评估维度都可以被看作是在引入一个经过奖励加权的条件速度场。 当多个维度倾向于不兼容的生成行为时，它们在重叠的含噪潜在区域中可能产生冲突的速度方向。 由于 MSE 目标学习的是条件均值目标，与共享 LoRA 的联合训练可能会平均这些方向，从而引发梯度干扰和能力平均。 为了解决这个问题，我们在训练分组适配器之前，会根据测得的优化兼容性对数据类别进行组织。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we propose G 3 -LoRA: G radient- G uided G rouped LoRA. The method first computes a reward-weighted gradient for each data category using the same flow-matching loss used in training ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) . It then computes a global mixed gradient and removes the component of each category gradient explained by this shared direction. The residual gradients define a compatibility matrix: positive cosine similarity suggests that two categories induce similar category-specific update directions, while negative similarity suggests potential interference. We cluster this matrix into groups, train one LoRA expert per group, and merge the experts into a final adapter. Because merging can dilute group-specific updates, we then distill the experts into the merged adapter on its own sampling trajectories (on-policy distillation, OPD) ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出了 G 3 -LoRA：梯度引导分组 LoRA。 该方法首先使用训练中所用的相同流匹配损失（Lipman 等人，2023）为每个数据类别计算奖励加权的梯度。 接着，它计算一个全局混合梯度，并移除每个类别梯度中由该共享方向所解释的部分。 残差梯度定义了一个兼容性矩阵：正的余弦相似度表明两个类别会引发相似的类别特定更新方向，而负的相似度则表明可能存在干扰。 我们将该矩阵聚类成多个组，为每个组训练一个 LoRA 专家，然后将这些专家合并为一个最终的适配器。 由于合并过程可能会削弱与特定组相关的更新，我们随后在其自身的采样轨迹上对合并后的适配器进行专家蒸馏（在线策略蒸馏，OPD）（Agarwal 等人，2024；Fang 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We formulate heterogeneous video post-training as a data organization problem: categories should be grouped according to optimization compatibility, not only semantic labels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将异质视频后训练问题表述为一个数据组织问题：类别的分组应基于优化兼容性，而不仅仅是语义标签。

paragraphs.en: We connect reward-weighted flow SFT to reward-reweighted velocity-field regression, providing a local mechanism for capability averaging under shared LoRA training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将奖励加权的流式 SFT 与奖励重新加权的速度场回归相结合，为共享 LoRA 训练下的能力平均提供了一种局部机制。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a residual gradient compatibility measure that subtracts the global mixed update direction before comparing category-specific gradients, and show that the conflict it reveals is reproducible across probe sets and backbones and predicts held-out transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种残差梯度兼容性度量方法，该方法在比较特定类别的梯度之前，会先减去全局混合更新方向，并证明了其所揭示的冲突在不同探针集和骨干网络中均可重现，且能够预测保留数据的迁移效果。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the method on two video backbones with matched grouping controls, an independent evaluator, and paired bootstrap intervals, and we locate where merging loses specialist capability and how much on-policy distillation recovers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个具有匹配分组控制、独立评估器和成对自助区间的视频主干网络上实例化了该方法，并确定了合并过程在何处会丧失专业能力，以及在线策略蒸馏能在多大程度上恢复这种能力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 visualizes the matrix used for grouping. The strongest positive pairs are not arbitrary semantic neighbors: material and thermotics have mean similarity 0.841, dynamic attribute and thermotics have 0.824, and human anatomy and human identity consistency have 0.709. Conversely, the stable negative pairs reveal conflicts that a naive semantic grouping could miss, such as human clothes consistency versus thermotics (-0.818), dynamic attribute versus human clothes consistency (-0.798), and motion order versus multi-view consistency (-0.630). These values are averaged over five probe stages, making the matrix a staged compatibility estimate rather than a single-batch diagnostic.

paragraphs.en: We choose M = 5 M=5 because it gives a cleaner residual-gradient partition than M = 4 M=4 . Under average-linkage clustering on D = 1 − S ¯ D=1-\bar{S} , the M = 5 M=5 split increases within-group mean similarity from 0.345 to 0.473, improves the within-minus-between separation from 0.559 to 0.633, and removes all negative within-group pairs. paragraphs.en: This grouping has two uses in the paper. First, it is a diagnostic result: it shows that reward-weighted category gradients contain structure that is not visible from metric names alone. Second, it defines the grouped-LoRA training plan: each group trains one LoRA expert, and the experts are merged before VBench2.0 evaluation. The downstream results below show that the grouping improves the average score and reduces the worst dimension-level drop, but also exposes a dimension-level tradeoff: camera motion does not inherit the improvement obtained by joint LoRA. Appendix E provides the corresponding dendrogram and stage-wise heatmaps.
paragraphs.zh: 这种分组在论文中有两种用途。 首先，它是一种诊断结果：它表明奖励加权的类别梯度包含仅从指标名称中无法观察到的结构。 其次，它定义了分组 LoRA 训练方案：每个组训练一个 LoRA 专家，并且在 VBench2.0 评估前将这些专家进行合并。 下面的下游结果表明，这种分组提高了平均分数并减少了最差维度级别的下降，但也暴露出一种维度级别的权衡：相机运动并未继承联合 LoRA 所带来的改进。 附录 E 提供了相应的树状图和分阶段热图。

Joint LoRA is slightly below the base model in mean score (-0.07), despite producing gains on camera motion (+8.00), mechanics (+5.18), multi-view consistency (+4.64), and dynamic spatial relationship (+4.00). sents.en: Joint LoRA is slightly below the base model in mean score (-0.07), despite producing gains on camera motion (+8.00), mechanics (+5.18), multi-view consistency (+4.64), and dynamic spatial relationship (+4.00).
sents.zh: 尽管联合LoRA在相机运动（+8.00）、机械结构（+5.18）、多视图一致性（+4.64）和动态空间关系（+4.00）方面取得了提升，但其平均得分仍略低于基础模型（-0.07）。

sents.en: This pattern is consistent with a single mixed adapter under heterogeneous reward weighting: some dimensions benefit, but the adapter also pays for the mixture with regressions in human interaction (-8.00), material (-7.63), and dynamic attribute (-6.00).
sents.zh: 这一模式与异质奖励权重下的单一混合适配器一致：某些维度受益，但适配器也因混合而付出了代价，体现在人类互动（-8.00）、材料（-7.63）和动态属性（-6.00）方面的退化。

paragraphs.en: The two random partitions are also weak: Random partition A reaches 46.38 mean score, while Random partition B reaches 45.82. Both are below the base model, joint LoRA, and Grouped LoRA. Random partition A improves 6 out of 17 dimensions with a worst dimension-level drop of -8.21, and Random partition B improves 8 dimensions but has a larger worst drop of -16.00. The semantic and raw-gradient partitions are only marginally above the base model (47.20 and 47.35); the semantic partition places 13 negatively related pairs in the same group, whereas the residual partition places none. These comparisons indicate that the benefit of the grouped adapter is not explained by simply splitting the 17 dimensions into several smaller LoRA experts; the partition itself matters.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种随机划分的效果也很弱：随机划分 A 的平均得分为 46.38，而随机划分 B 的平均得分为 45.82。 两者的得分都低于基础模型、联合 LoRA 和分组 LoRA。 随机划分 A 在 17 个维度中有 6 个得到提升，最差维度的下降幅度为 -8.21；而随机划分 B 虽然提升了 8 个维度，但最差的下降幅度更大，达到 -16.00。 语义划分和原始梯度划分的得分仅略高于基础模型（分别为 47.20 和 47.35）；语义划分将 13 对负相关项分到了同一组中，而残差划分则没有将任何一对分到同一组。 这些比较表明，分组适配器的优势并非仅仅通过将 17 个维度拆分成几个较小的 LoRA 专家所能解释的；划分方式本身至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Grouped LoRA increases the mean to 48.18, a +1.11 gain over the base model and a +1.19 gain over joint LoRA. The largest gains over the base model occur on multi-view consistency (+8.99), motion order understanding (+8.00), dynamic spatial relationship (+4.00), thermotics (+3.29), and complex landscape (+2.40). These improvements support the main hypothesis that grouping can reduce some forms of capability averaging: the grouped adapter improves the average tradeoff and substantially reduces the worst dimension-level drop compared with joint LoRA. The gain over the base model is positive in 96.6% of paired bootstrap resamples (95% CI [ − 0.08 , + 2.26 ] [-0.08,+2.26] ), so it is a consistent trend rather than a significant difference at the 5% level.

paragraphs.en: At the same time, the result is not a clean dominance claim. The grouped adapter still degrades material (-4.52), human interaction (-4.00), and several identity or clothing dimensions relative to the base model. It also gives up the joint LoRA’s camera-motion gain: camera motion remains at the base score of 12.00, while joint LoRA reaches 20.00. This is the clearest diagnostic contrast in Appendix Table 8 . VBench2.0 camera motion is a hard label match over CoTracker-estimated motion classes, so improving the mean score and multi-view consistency does not guarantee better camera-trajectory control.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates how these dimension-level differences can appear in generated videos. We choose one Composition prompt that requires a dog, a cat, and a basket to remain correctly bound over time, and one Thermotics prompt that requires a visible physical state change under heating. These examples target two different failure modes: relational binding among multiple entities and temporal transformation of material state.

paragraphs.en: In the Composition example, the base model produces the requested objects but the basket relation is mostly static. Grouped LoRA (Ours) keeps the dog, cat, and basket relation more coherent across the shown frames. In the Thermotics example, the base output remains close to a static cheese block, whereas Grouped LoRA (Ours) shows clearer gradual deformation, matching the intended heat-driven transformation. The cases therefore provide visual evidence for the same pattern seen in the automatic metrics: grouping is most helpful when the target dimension requires preserving a specific relation or transformation rather than merely increasing generic visual quality. They are single cases, however: over all Composition prompts, the score is essentially unchanged (47.80 versus 48.10).
paragraphs.zh: 在“构图”示例中，基础模型生成了所需的对象，但篮子之间的关系基本是静态的。 “分组 LoRA（我们的方法）”使狗、猫和篮子之间的关系在所展示的帧中保持一致性更高。 在“热力学”示例中，基础模型的输出仍然接近一个静态的奶酪块，而“分组 LoRA（我们的方法）”则表现出更清晰、渐进的形变，符合预期的受热驱动转变效果。 因此，这些案例为自动指标中观察到的相同模式提供了视觉证据：当目标维度需要保留特定的关系或转变，而不仅仅是提升通用的视觉质量时，分组最为有效。 然而，这些只是单个案例：在所有“构图”提示中，得分基本没有变化（47.80 对比 48.10）。

paragraphs.en: On CogVideoX-2B, which changes both the architecture and the training objective, joint training degrades the base model from 39.87 to 27.95, whereas the grouped adapter reaches 40.99 (Table 2 ). Most of this margin reflects avoided negative transfer rather than a large gain over the base model (+1.12). The joint degradation is already present at 25% of training (36.78), so checkpoint selection does not rescue it, and it is dimension-selective: human anatomy, human identity, and thermotics improve while human interaction, motion order, and motion rationality collapse (Appendix I ), consistent with capability averaging rather than a globally failed run.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CogVideoX-2B 上，该模型同时改变了架构和训练目标，联合训练使基础模型的性能从 39.87 下降至 27.95，而分组适配器则达到了 40.99（表 2）。 这一差距的大部分反映了避免了负迁移，而非相较于基础模型的大幅提升（+1.12）。 在训练进行到 25% 时，联合训练的性能下降已经显现（36.78），因此检查点选择无法挽救这种下降，且该现象具有维度选择性：人体解剖学、人类身份和热力学得到改善，而人类互动、运动顺序和运动合理性则急剧恶化（附录 I），这与能力平均化相符，而非整个运行过程全面失败。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether merging contributes to the remaining dimension-level tradeoffs, we compare each group expert with the merged adapter on its assigned dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估合并是否有助于解决剩余的维度级权衡问题，我们将每个组专家与其分配到的维度上的合并适配器进行比较。

paragraphs.en: In the matched retention evaluation (Appendix G ; group-only row of Figure 3 ), group-only LoRAs reach 48.06 on their assigned dimensions, compared with 48.18 for the merged grouped adapter and 47.07 for the base model. The small average merge gap suggests no global capability collapse, while the larger gaps on multi-view consistency and mechanics indicate that weight-space merging is a plausible source of remaining group-specific tradeoffs. On all six dimensions where the expert beats the base model, the merged adapter is below the expert; on the other eleven, it is above the expert, indicating transfer across groups. Selecting post hoc the better of the two for each dimension gives a diagnostic upper bound of 51.07. Neither rank truncation (error 1.5 × 10 − 6 1.5\times 10^{-6} ) nor sign cancellation between expert deltas (no negative pair in 240 modules) explains this loss (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 在匹配保留能力评估中（附录 G；图 3 的仅组行），仅组的 LoRAs 在其指定维度上达到了 48.06，而合并后的分组适配器为 48.18，基础模型则为 47.07。 较小的平均合并差距表明没有出现全局能力崩溃，而在多视角一致性和力学方面的较大差距则说明，权重空间合并可能是造成剩余组特异性权衡的潜在原因。 在专家模型优于基础模型的全部六个维度上，合并后的适配器表现均低于专家模型；而在其余十一个维度上，其表现高于专家模型，这表明存在跨组的迁移能力。 事后为每个维度选择两者中表现更好的结果，可得出一个诊断性上限为 51.07。 无论是秩截断（误差 1.5 × 10⁻⁶）还是专家差异之间的符号抵消（240 个模块中无负值对），都无法解释这种性能损失（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video generation builds on diffusion and flow-based modeling ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) , with evaluation moving toward multi-axis diagnosis through EvalCrafter, T2V-CompBench, VideoPhy, VBench, and VBench2.0 ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . We use VBench2.0 dimensions as both metrics and data categories. Diffusion alignment and efficient video generation are reviewed by Liu et al. (2026) and Shao et al. (2026) , respectively. Zigzag Diffusion Sampling ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and Weak-to-Strong Diffusion with Reflection ( Bai et al., 2026a ) improve generation through reflective sampling without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频生成技术基于扩散模型和流式建模（Ho 等，2020；Rombach 等，2022；Peebles & Xie，2023；Blattmann 等，2023），其评估正通过 EvalCrafter、T2V-CompBench、VideoPhy、VBench 和 VBench2.0（Liu 等，2023；Sun 等，2024；Bansal 等，2024；Huang 等，2024；Zheng 等，2025）向多轴诊断方向发展。 我们将 VBench2.0 的各个维度同时用作评估指标和数据类别。 Liu 等（2026）和 Shao 等（2026）分别对扩散模型对齐与高效视频生成进行了综述。 Zigzag Diffusion Sampling（Bai 等，2025a）和 Weak-to-Strong Diffusion with Reflection（Bai 等，2026a）通过反射采样实现了无需重新训练的生成优化。

CRAFT ( Sun et al., 2026 ) studies composite-reward filtering followed by supervised fine-tuning; our focus is instead on which reward-weighted categories should share updates.

paragraphs.en: The grouping signal is related to gradient conflict and multi-task optimization methods ( Sener & Koltun, 2018 ; Chen et al., 2018 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) , while the merged adapter connects to weight-space merging ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ; Matena & Raffel, 2022 ; Ilharco et al., 2023 ; Yadav et al., 2023 ) . G 3 -LoRA intervenes between these lines: it probes residual category gradients before training specialists, then merges the resulting LoRA experts into one deployable adapter. CASA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) addresses spectral interference when transferring LoRAs to distilled video backbones, whereas we group and merge experts trained on the same backbone.

paragraphs.en: Our consolidation follows on-policy distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) and the multi-teacher paradigm of Flow-OPD ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Our distinction lies in constructing teachers by residual-gradient grouping of reward-weighted video categories, rather than by single-reward specialization. paragraphs.en: This study covers two open text-to-video backbones of at most 2B parameters and a VBench2.0-derived category taxonomy; on CogVideoX-2B the gain over the base model is small, so the most natural next step is to test whether the same grouping signal appears across larger model families, reward sources, and evaluation suites. Rewards come from Qwen3-VL and VBench2.0 also uses vision-language judgments; VideoScore agreement reduces but does not remove this coupling, and no human study was run. On Wan2.1, the 95% interval of the merged adapter’s gain over the base model includes zero. OPD adds about 205 GPU-hours and was not applied to the control partitions or to CogVideoX. Our gradient compatibility measure is also intentionally lightweight: it is designed as a practical probe for organizing post-training data rather than as a complete account of all denoising dynamics. Future work could combine this probe with richer merge rules, repeated control partitions, and human preference studies to further separate data-organization effects from evaluator- or merge-specific effects.

paragraphs.en: We presented G 3 -LoRA, a gradient-guided procedure for organizing heterogeneous reward-weighted post-training data. The method computes category gradients, removes the shared global direction, clusters residual compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them by merging and on-policy distillation. The central view is that reward-weighted video SFT induces multiple conditional velocity fields, and post-training should ask not only which samples are high quality, but also which reward-weighted samples should share update directions. VBench2.0 results support this view in a qualified way: Grouped LoRA improves the mean score over both the base model and joint LoRA, while reducing the worst dimension-level drop; it avoids joint training’s negative transfer on CogVideoX-2B, and distillation recovers part of the merging loss. Overall, the results position gradient compatibility as a practical organizing signal for reward-weighted video post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 G 3 -LoRA，这是一种用于组织异质奖励加权后训练数据的梯度引导方法。 该方法计算类别梯度，移除共享的全局方向，对残差兼容性进行聚类，训练特定小组的 LoRA 专家，并通过合并与策略蒸馏将其整合。 核心观点是：奖励加权的视频 SFT 会引发多个条件速度场，因此后训练不仅需要判断哪些样本质量高，还需要明确哪些奖励加权样本应共享更新方向。 VBench2.0 的结果以可靠的方式支持了这一观点：分组 LoRA 在平均得分上优于基础模型和联合 LoRA，同时降低了最差维度级别的下降；它避免了联合训练在 CogVideoX-2B 上的负迁移问题，而蒸馏则恢复了部分合并损失。 总体而言，这些结果表明梯度兼容性是组织奖励加权视频后训练的一种实用信号。

paragraphs.en: The method is a post-training data organization procedure and does not directly introduce a new video generation backbone. Its positive impact is that it may make post-training more data-efficient and more diagnosable by exposing when training categories interfere. Its negative impact follows the underlying model class: improved video generation can also improve misleading or harmful generated media. Any future release of trained adapters or generated videos should therefore follow the safety and licensing constraints of the base model and benchmark assets, and should document whether generated samples are filtered before release.

paragraphs.en: The reward pipeline converts each generated training video into a scalar sample weight. It uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct in two stages. Second, Qwen watches the generated video and answers each QA item with either “Yes” or “No”. paragraphs.en: For Motion Order Understanding, the QA-generation template instructs Qwen to identify the main subject’s core action events and produce two to four yes/no questions about their temporal order. For example, if the prompt describes a subject clapping, bending down, and then picking up a bag, the generated QA items should ask whether the earlier action happens before the later action, or whether the later action starts after the earlier action finishes. The template explicitly excludes camera movement, shot changes, clothing, background, and other non-action properties so that the reward targets event order rather than general visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在动作顺序理解任务中，问答生成模板会指导 Qwen 识别主要主体的核心动作事件，并生成两到四个关于这些事件时间顺序的“是/否”问题。 例如，如果提示描述了一个主体先拍手、然后弯腰、接着拿起一个包，那么生成的问答项应询问较早的动作是否发生在较晚的动作之前，或者较晚的动作是否在较早的动作结束后才开始。 该模板明确排除了摄像机移动、镜头切换、服装、背景以及其他非动作属性，以确保奖励机制针对事件顺序而非整体视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: To separate group training quality from merge-induced compression, we run a retention evaluation on the five group-specific LoRA experts. Each group-only LoRA is evaluated only on the VBench2.0 dimensions assigned to that group, and the resulting dimension scores are compared with the base model and the merged rank-40 adapter under a matched quick-evaluation protocol. This is an oracle-style diagnostic rather than a deployable single-model result: it asks whether the merged adapter preserves the capabilities learned by the group experts, rather than only whether the final merged model improves the average score.

Joint and grouped training use the same 9,520 videos, prompts, reward weights, and LoRA and optimizer configuration (LoRA rank 128, α = 128 \alpha=128 , learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} ); each sample is seen exactly once, because the five experts train on disjoint subsets whose sizes sum to 9,520. The five rank-128 experts are merged exactly into a rank-640 adapter ( α = 640 \alpha=640 ). Scores are VBench2.0 macro means over 17 dimensions; multi-view consistency is 0 for all CogVideoX methods.

paragraphs.en: Joint LoRA is already below the base model at 25% exposure, and even its best retained checkpoint remains below both the base model and the grouped adapter, so early stopping would not change the comparison. The degradation is dimension-selective: human anatomy (48.5 to 98.4), human identity (70.9 to 97.9), and thermotics (46.8 to 56.0) improve under Joint LoRA, while composition, camera motion, mechanics, human interaction, motion order, and motion rationality deteriorate. The grouped–Joint difference of + 13.04 +13.04 points has a paired prompt-cluster 95% bootstrap interval of [ + 9.08 , + 16.92 ] [+9.08,+16.92] .
paragraphs.zh: 在 25% 的暴露度下，联合 LoRA 的性能已经低于基础模型，而且其保留效果最好的检查点也仍然低于基础模型和分组适配器，因此提前停止并不会改变这种比较结果。 性能下降具有维度选择性：在联合 LoRA 下，人体解剖学（从 48.5 提升至 98.4）、人类身份识别（从 70.9 提升至 97.9）和热力学（从 46.8 提升至 56.0）得到改善，而构图、相机运动、机械原理、人类互动、运动顺序和运动合理性则出现恶化。 分组模型与联合模型之间 +13.04 分的差异，其配对提示簇的 95% 自助置信区间为 [ +9.08 , +16.92 ]。

We report the point estimate, the 95% percentile interval over 10,000 resamples, and the fraction of resamples with a positive difference.
